Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misassigned the directors’ death dates—attributing 1941-10-26 to Thomas N. Heffron and 1951-05-24 to Victor Schertzinger—despite sources showing Heffron died in 1951 and Schertzinger in 1941. This swap led to the incorrect conclusion that The Love Charm’s director died earlier; correctly, The Constant Woman’s director (Schertzinger) died earlier.
